data.name: ReCarbn
data.description: ReCarbn was a Dutch direct air capture startup spun out of the University of Twente in 2022, developing circulating solid-sorbent DAC technology focused on filtration and sorbent circulation. In December 2024, it was acquired by Amsterdam-based Skytree, which absorbed ReCarbn's IP and moved all three co-founders into Skytree leadership roles, so it no longer operates as a standalone company.
